content: This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this medication and your specific health needs. How to Use: Take this medication orally with a full glass of water (8 ounces or 240 milliliters) as directed by your doctor. Unless otherwise instructed by your doctor, ensure you drink plenty of fluids during treatment. For optimal effectiveness, take this antibiotic at evenly spaced intervals. Continue taking the medication for the full prescribed duration, even if your symptoms improve after a few days. Side Effects: Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, or headache. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Rarely, this medication may cause a severe intestinal condition due to a bacteria called Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile). This condition can occur during treatment or weeks to months after treatment has stopped. Prolonged or repeated use of this medication may lead to oral thrush or a new vaginal yeast infection. Rare but serious side effects include severe allergic reactions, a peeling skin rash (e.g., Stevens-Johnson syndrome), blood disorders (e.g., agranulocytosis, aplastic anemia), liver damage, or lung injury. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before taking sulfadiazine, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to sulfa medications, or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. Sulfadiazine may interfere with the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines (e.g., typhoid vaccine). This medication may increase your sensitivity to sunlight. Limit your time in the sun, avoid tanning booths and sunlamps, and use sunscreen and protective clothing when outdoors. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed. It should not be used near the expected delivery date due to potential harm to the unborn baby. This drug passes into breast milk. While no harm has been reported in healthy infants, it may have undesirable effects on infants who are ill, premature, or have certain conditions (e.g., jaundice, high bilirubin levels, G6PD deficiency). Breastfeeding is not recommended for infants with these conditions. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk for serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription/nonprescription drugs and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Important Notes: This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only. If you are using this medication for an extended period, laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., complete blood count, kidney function) should be performed while you are taking this medication. Keep all medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of the next dose, skip the missed dose. Take your next dose at the regular time. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information Usage: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
